summary: The existing reason still holds. The paper (PMC12270663) has one supplement, mmc1.docx, which holds in vivo statistics only and no RNA-seq results. Its data-sharing statement points to GEO and says full datasets are available on request. Figure 6 gives only DEG counts (WT cagrilintide MBH 404: 96 up, 308 down). The only GEO series supplement is GSE296488_RAW.tar, the per-sample TPM files already pinned. With no gene-level author effects there are 0 paired genes, below the 30 that author-concordance-v2 needs, so concordance stays not assessed. This is missing evidence, not a mismatch. No ledger changes are proposed.
